# 2 Packages and Parameters

```{r packages, cache=FALSE}
pkgs <- c("redist","redistmetrics","tidyverse","tidycensus",
          "tigris","sf","readxl","scales","knitr","kableExtra",
          "patchwork","gridExtra","magick","webshot2")
for (p in pkgs) if (!requireNamespace(p, quietly = TRUE))
  install.packages(p, repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org")

library(redist); library(redistmetrics); library(tidyverse)
library(tidycensus); library(tigris); library(sf)
library(readxl); library(scales); library(knitr)
library(kableExtra); library(patchwork); library(gridExtra)
library(magick); library(webshot2)

options(tigris_use_cache = TRUE)

NSIMS             <- 5000L
CENSUS_KEY        <- NULL        
SKIP_LARGE_STATES <- FALSE
CHECKPOINT_DIR    <- "sim_checkpoints"
OUTPUT_DIR        <- "output_figures"

if (!dir.exists(CHECKPOINT_DIR)) dir.create(CHECKPOINT_DIR)
if (!dir.exists(OUTPUT_DIR))     dir.create(OUTPUT_DIR)


USE_CENSUS_API <- file.exists("tract_pops.rds") && file.exists("minority_vap.rds")

if (USE_CENSUS_API) {
  cat("Census cache files found — will use exact tract populations.\n")
} else {
  cat("No Census cache — using vote-count population approximation.\n")
  cat("Run download_census_data.R locally and copy .rds files to this folder.\n")
}

save_fig <- function(plot_obj, filename, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300) {
  path <- file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, paste0(filename, ".png"))
  ggsave(path, plot = plot_obj, width = width, height = height,
         dpi = dpi, bg = "white")
  cat(sprintf("  Saved: %s\n", path))
  plot_obj
}

save_table <- function(df, filename, title = "", col_names = NULL) {
  df_chr <- df %>% mutate(across(everything(), as.character))
  if (!is.null(col_names)) names(df_chr) <- col_names

  n_rows <- nrow(df_chr)
  n_cols <- ncol(df_chr)

  col_char_widths <- purrr::map_dbl(seq_len(n_cols), function(i) {
    max(nchar(df_chr[[i]]), nchar(names(df_chr)[i]))
  })
  est_width_in <- sum(col_char_widths * 0.11) + n_cols * 0.3

  tbl_grob <- tableGrob(df_chr, rows = NULL,
                         theme = ttheme_minimal(base_size = 9))

  path <- file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, paste0(filename, ".png"))

  ggsave(path, plot = tbl_grob,
         width  = max(8, est_width_in * 1.15),
         height = max(3, n_rows * 0.35 + 1),
         dpi = 300, bg = "white")

  img <- magick::image_read(path) |>
    magick::image_trim() |>
    magick::image_border("white", "30x30")

  if (nzchar(title)) {
    info <- magick::image_info(img)
    img <- magick::image_extent(
      img,
      geometry = magick::geometry_size_pixels(width = info$width, height = info$height + 100),
      gravity  = "south",
      color    = "white"
    )
    img <- magick::image_annotate(
      img, title, gravity = "north", size = 46, weight = 700,
      location = "+0+20", color = "black"
    )
  }

  magick::image_write(img, path)
  cat(sprintf("  Saved: %s\n", path))
  invisible(df)
}

save_kable_png <- function(kable_obj, filename, zoom = 3, border = NULL) {
  path <- file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, paste0(filename, ".png"))
  kableExtra::save_kable(kable_obj, file = path, zoom = zoom)
  if (!is.null(border)) {
    magick::image_read(path) |>
      magick::image_border("white", border) |>
      magick::image_write(path)
  }
  cat(sprintf("  Saved: %s\n", path))
  invisible(kable_obj)
}


tbl_title <- function(title) {
  sprintf("<div style='width:100%%; text-align:center; font-size:20px; font-weight:700;'>%s</div>", title)
}


set.seed(1986)

theme_set(
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
    theme(
      plot.title    = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
      plot.caption  = element_text(hjust = 1),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
)
```

# 3.2 Census Tract Populations and Minority VAP
```{r census-api}

if (USE_CENSUS_API) {
  cat("Loading tract_pops.rds...\n")
  tract_pops <- readRDS("tract_pops.rds")
  cat(sprintf("  tract_pops: %d tracts loaded\n", nrow(tract_pops)))

  cat("Loading minority_vap.rds...\n")
  minority_vap <- readRDS("minority_vap.rds")
  cat(sprintf("  minority_vap: %d tracts loaded\n", nrow(minority_vap)))

  tract_pops <- tract_pops %>%
    left_join(sf::st_drop_geometry(minority_vap) %>% select(GEOID, minority_vap_frac),
              by = "GEOID")

  cat(sprintf("  Combined: %d tracts with pop + minority VAP\n", nrow(tract_pops)))
} else {
  cat("Census .rds files not found — using vote-count approximation.\n")
  tract_pops   <- NULL
  minority_vap <- NULL
}
```

# 4 Apportionment

```{r apportionment}

huntington_hill <- function(pops, total_seats) {
  seats <- rep(1L, length(pops))
  for (i in seq_len(total_seats - length(pops))) {
    priority <- pops / sqrt(seats * (seats + 1L))
    seats[which.max(priority)] <- seats[which.max(priority)] + 1L
  }
  seats
}


state_pops <- state_pops %>%
  mutate(
    seats_435       = huntington_hill(pop_2020, 435L),
    seats_692       = huntington_hill(pop_2020, 692L),
    seats_gained    = seats_692 - seats_435,
    pop_per_rep_435 = round(pop_2020 / seats_435),
    pop_per_rep_692 = round(pop_2020 / seats_692)
  )

apportionment_kable <- state_pops %>%
  select(state_name, pop_2020, seats_435, seats_692,
         seats_gained, pop_per_rep_435, pop_per_rep_692) %>%
  mutate(across(c(pop_2020, pop_per_rep_435, pop_per_rep_692), comma)) %>%
  kable(col.names = c("State","Population","Seats (435)","Seats (692)",
                      "Gained","Pop/Rep (435)","Pop/Rep (692)"),
        align   = c("l","l","r","r","r","r","r"),
        caption = tbl_title("Huntington-Hill Apportionment"),
        escape  = FALSE) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped","hover","condensed"),
                position = "center", full_width = FALSE, font_size = 11) %>%
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE)

apportionment_kable

save_kable_png(apportionment_kable, "apportionment")
```

# 5 Actual 2024 Election Results (435-Seat Baseline)

```{r actual-results}
no_total_states <- c("ALASKA","ARIZONA","ARKANSAS","HAWAII","IOWA",
                     "MARYLAND","NORTH CAROLINA","SOUTH CAROLINA","WEST VIRGINIA")

raw <- read_csv(
  "HOUSE_precinct_general.csv",
  col_types = cols(county_fips = col_character(),
                   district    = col_character(),
                   votes       = col_double(),
                   .default    = col_character()),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(
    special = as.logical(special),
    writein = as.logical(writein),
    votes   = as.numeric(votes)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !special | is.na(special),
    !writein | is.na(writein),
    office == "US HOUSE"
  )

actual_district <- raw %>%
  filter(party_simplified %in% c("DEMOCRAT","REPUBLICAN")) %>%
  mutate(keep = if_else(state %in% no_total_states, TRUE, mode == "TOTAL")) %>%
  filter(keep) %>%
  group_by(state, district, party_simplified) %>%
  summarise(votes = sum(votes, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from  = party_simplified,
              values_from = votes,
              values_fill = 0) %>%
  rename(dem_votes = DEMOCRAT, rep_votes = REPUBLICAN) %>%
  mutate(
    total_votes = dem_votes + rep_votes,
    dem_frac    = if_else(total_votes > 0, dem_votes / total_votes, NA_real_)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !district %in% c("STATEWIDE","AT-LARGE",""),
    !is.na(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(district)))
  )

actual_state <- actual_district %>%
  group_by(state) %>%
  summarise(
    n_districts   = n(),
    dem_seats     = sum(dem_frac > 0.50, na.rm = TRUE),
    rep_seats     = sum(dem_frac < 0.50, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_dem      = mean(dem_frac, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_dem    = median(dem_frac, na.rm = TRUE),
    bias          = mean(dem_frac, na.rm=TRUE) - median(dem_frac, na.rm=TRUE),
    pct_comp      = mean(dem_frac >= 0.45 & dem_frac <= 0.55, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    bias_dir = case_when(
      bias >  0.01 ~ "Pro-Republican",
      bias < -0.01 ~ "Pro-Democratic",
      TRUE         ~ "Neutral"
    )
  )

cat("Districts:", nrow(actual_district), "\n")
cat("States:", n_distinct(actual_district$state), "\n")

actual_state %>%
  mutate(
    bias     = round(bias, 4),
    pct_comp = percent(pct_comp, accuracy = 0.1)
  ) %>%
  kable(
    col.names = c("State","Districts","Dem Seats","Rep Seats",
                  "Mean Dem","Median Dem","Bias","% Comp","Direction"),
    caption   = "Actual 2024 Results by State (435-Seat System)",
    digits    = 3
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped","hover","condensed"),
                position = "center", full_width = FALSE, font_size = 10)
```

# 7 SMC Simulations

# 7.1 Helper Functions

```{r helper-functions}

get_county_votes <- function(state_upper) {
  mode_filter <- if (state_upper %in% no_total_states) {
    unique(raw$mode)   
  } else {
    "TOTAL"            
  }

  raw %>%
    filter(
      state             == state_upper,
      party_simplified  %in% c("DEMOCRAT","REPUBLICAN"),
      mode              %in% mode_filter
    ) %>%
    mutate(county_fips = str_pad(county_fips, 5, "left", "0")) %>%
    group_by(county_fips, party_simplified) %>%
    summarise(votes = sum(votes, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from  = party_simplified,
                values_from = votes,
                values_fill = 0) %>%
    rename(dem_votes = DEMOCRAT, rep_votes = REPUBLICAN) %>%
    mutate(
      total_votes = dem_votes + rep_votes,
      dem_frac    = if_else(total_votes > 0, dem_votes / total_votes, NA_real_)
    )
}


get_geometry <- function(fips_code, min_units, state_label) {

  levels <- if (USE_CENSUS_API) {
    c("vtd", "tract", "county")
  } else {
    c("tract", "county")
  }

  for (geo_level in levels) {

    result <- tryCatch({
      g <- switch(geo_level,
        vtd   = tigris::voting_districts(state = fips_code, year = 2020),
        tract = tigris::tracts(state = fips_code, year = 2020, cb = TRUE),
        county = tigris::counties(state = fips_code, year = 2020, cb = TRUE)
      )
      if (is.null(g) || nrow(g) < max(min_units, 2L)) NULL else g
    }, error = function(e) NULL)

    if (!is.null(result)) {
      cat(sprintf("     geometry: %s (%d units)\n", geo_level, nrow(result)))
      flush.console()
      return(result %>% st_transform(crs = 3857))
    }

    cat(sprintf("     %s unavailable — trying next\n", geo_level))
    flush.console()
  }

  stop(sprintf("All geometry options failed for %s", state_label))
}


patch_adjacency <- function(shp) {

  touches <- sf::st_touches(shp)
  adj <- lapply(touches, function(x) as.integer(x) - 1L)  

  n    <- nrow(shp)
  comp <- integer(n)
  cid  <- 0L

  for (start in seq_len(n)) {
    if (comp[start] != 0L) next
    cid   <- cid + 1L
    queue <- start
    while (length(queue) > 0) {
      cur        <- queue[1]; queue <- queue[-1]
      if (comp[cur] != 0L) next
      comp[cur]  <- cid
      nbrs       <- adj[[cur]] + 1L
      unvisited  <- nbrs[comp[nbrs] == 0L]
      queue      <- c(queue, unvisited)
    }
  }

  n_comp <- max(comp)

  if (n_comp > 1L) {
    cat(sprintf("     %d components found — bridging %d island unit(s)\n",
                n_comp, sum(comp != which.max(tabulate(comp)))))
    flush.console()

    main_id    <- which.max(tabulate(comp))
    main_idx   <- which(comp == main_id)
    island_idx <- which(comp != main_id)
    cents      <- sf::st_centroid(sf::st_geometry(shp))

    for (iso in island_idx) {
      dists   <- as.numeric(sf::st_distance(cents[iso], cents[main_idx]))
      nearest <- main_idx[which.min(dists)]
      iso0    <- iso - 1L
      near0   <- nearest - 1L
      if (!near0 %in% adj[[iso]])     adj[[iso]]     <- c(adj[[iso]],     near0)
      if (!iso0  %in% adj[[nearest]]) adj[[nearest]] <- c(adj[[nearest]], iso0)
    }
  }

  adj
}


build_state_map <- function(state_name_title, fips_code, ndists, mm_min = 0L) {

  state_upper <- str_to_upper(state_name_title)

  # 1. County-level election data
  elect <- get_county_votes(state_upper)
  state_mean_dem <- mean(elect$dem_frac, na.rm = TRUE)
  cat(sprintf("     counties in election data: %d\n", nrow(elect)))
  flush.console()

  # 2. Geometry
  geo <- get_geometry(fips_code, min_units = ndists + 1L,
                      state_label = state_name_title)

  # 3. Standardise GEOID column
  geoid_col <- if ("GEOID20" %in% names(geo)) "GEOID20" else "GEOID"
  geo <- geo %>%
    mutate(
      GEOID_unit      = .data[[geoid_col]],
      county_fips_geo = str_sub(.data[[geoid_col]], 1, 5)
    ) %>%
    select(GEOID_unit, county_fips_geo, geometry)

  # 4. Join county vote data to geometry units
  joined <- geo %>%
    left_join(elect, by = c("county_fips_geo" = "county_fips")) %>%
    mutate(
      dem_frac    = coalesce(dem_frac,    state_mean_dem),
      dem_votes   = coalesce(dem_votes,   0),
      rep_votes   = coalesce(rep_votes,   0),
      total_votes = coalesce(total_votes, 0)
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(geometry)) %>%
    group_by(county_fips_geo) %>%
    mutate(
      n_in_county = n(),
      dem_votes   = dem_votes   / n_in_county,
      rep_votes   = rep_votes   / n_in_county,
      total_votes = total_votes / n_in_county
    ) %>%
    ungroup()

  # 5. Assign population and minority VAP
  if (USE_CENSUS_API && !is.null(tract_pops)) {

    state_tracts <- tract_pops %>%
      filter(str_sub(GEOID, 1, 2) == fips_code)

    joined <- joined %>%
      left_join(
        sf::st_drop_geometry(state_tracts) %>%
          select(GEOID, pop_tract, minority_vap_frac),
        by = c("GEOID_unit" = "GEOID")
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        pop           = as.integer(coalesce(pop_tract, 0L)),
        minority_frac = coalesce(minority_vap_frac, state_mean_dem)
      )

  } else {
    joined <- joined %>%
      mutate(
        pop           = if_else(total_votes > 0,
                                as.integer(round(total_votes * 2.1)), 0L),
        minority_frac = dem_frac  
      )
  }

  joined <- joined %>% mutate(pop = pmax(as.integer(pop), 1L))

  cat(sprintf("     units: %d | pop range: %d-%d\n",
              nrow(joined), min(joined$pop), max(joined$pop)))
  flush.console()

  # 6. Build patched adjacency
  adj <- patch_adjacency(joined)

  # 7. Population tolerance
  pop_tolerance <- if (USE_CENSUS_API) 0.01 else 0.20

  rmap <- redist_map(
    joined,
    ndists    = ndists,
    pop_tol   = pop_tolerance,
    total_pop = pop,
    adj       = adj
  )

  cat(sprintf("     redist_map: %d units, %d districts, pop_tol=%.0f%%\n",
              nrow(rmap), ndists, pop_tolerance * 100))
  flush.console()
  rmap
}

run_smc <- function(map_obj, nsims) {
  redist_smc(
    map_obj,
    nsims       = nsims,
    compactness = 1,
    runs        = 2L, 
    verbose     = TRUE
  )
}


compute_plan_metrics <- function(plans_obj, map_obj) {
  plans_obj %>%
    mutate(
      dem_share   = group_frac(map_obj, dem_votes, total_votes),
      max_pop_dev = plan_parity(map_obj)
    ) %>%
    group_by(draw) %>%
    summarise(
      n_districts      = n(),
      mean_dem         = mean(dem_share, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_dem       = median(dem_share, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_median_diff = mean_dem - median_dem,
      pct_competitive  = mean(dem_share >= 0.45 & dem_share <= 0.55,
                               na.rm = TRUE),
      dem_seats        = sum(dem_share > 0.50, na.rm = TRUE),
      rep_seats        = sum(dem_share < 0.50, na.rm = TRUE),
      max_pop_dev      = first(max_pop_dev),
      .groups          = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      bias_dir = case_when(
        mean_median_diff >  0.01 ~ "Pro-Republican",
        mean_median_diff < -0.01 ~ "Pro-Democratic",
        TRUE                     ~ "Neutral"
      )
    )
}
```

# 7.2 Simulation Loop

```{r sim-setup, cache=FALSE}
LARGE_STATES    <- c("California","Texas","New York","Florida")

sim_states <- state_pops %>%
  filter(seats_692 > 1) %>%
  { if (SKIP_LARGE_STATES) filter(., !state_name %in% LARGE_STATES) else . } %>%
  left_join(vra_constraints %>% select(state_name, mm_min_692),
            by = "state_name") %>%
  mutate(
    mm_min_692  = replace_na(mm_min_692, 0L),
    state_upper = str_to_upper(state_name)
  ) %>%
  arrange(seats_692)  

results_list <- vector("list", nrow(sim_states))
names(results_list) <- sim_states$state_name

ckpts <- list.files(CHECKPOINT_DIR, pattern = "\\.rds$", full.names = TRUE)
for (f in ckpts) {
  s <- readRDS(f)
  if (s$state_name %in% names(results_list)) {
    results_list[[s$state_name]] <- s$metrics
    cat("Checkpoint loaded:", s$state_name, "\n")
  }
}

states_to_run <- sim_states[sapply(results_list, is.null), ]
cat("\nStates to simulate:", nrow(states_to_run), "\n")
if (SKIP_LARGE_STATES)
  cat("Skipping (large):", paste(LARGE_STATES, collapse=", "), "\n")
```

```{r simulation-loop, cache=FALSE}

n_total <- nrow(states_to_run)
t_start <- proc.time()[["elapsed"]]

for (i in seq_len(n_total)) {

  nm    <- states_to_run$state_name[i]
  fips  <- states_to_run$fips[i]
  seats <- states_to_run$seats_692[i]
  mm    <- states_to_run$mm_min_692[i]

  elapsed <- proc.time()[["elapsed"]] - t_start
  eta     <- if (i > 1) elapsed / (i - 1) * (n_total - i + 1) else NA_real_

  cat(sprintf(
    "\n══ [%d/%d] %s | seats: %d | MM floor: %d | elapsed: %.0fmin%s ══\n",
    i, n_total, nm, seats, mm, elapsed/60,
    if (!is.na(eta)) sprintf(" | ETA: ~%.0fmin", eta/60) else ""
  ))
  flush.console()

  tryCatch({

    t0 <- proc.time()[["elapsed"]]

    cat("  [1/3] Building map...\n"); flush.console()
    map_i <- build_state_map(nm, fips, seats, mm_min = mm)

    cat("  [2/3] Running SMC (verbose output follows)...\n"); flush.console()
    plans_i <- run_smc(map_i, NSIMS)

    cat("  Convergence summary:\n"); flush.console()
    print(summary(plans_i))

    cat("  [3/3] Computing metrics...\n"); flush.console()
    metrics_i <- compute_plan_metrics(plans_i, map_i) %>%
      mutate(state = nm, ndists = seats)

    cat(sprintf("  ✓ %s complete in %.0fs | %d plans\n",
                nm, proc.time()[["elapsed"]] - t0, nrow(metrics_i)))
    flush.console()

    results_list[[nm]] <- metrics_i

    saveRDS(list(state_name = nm, metrics = metrics_i),
            file.path(CHECKPOINT_DIR,
                      paste0(gsub(" ","_", nm), ".rds")))
    cat(sprintf("  Checkpoint saved: %s\n", nm)); flush.console()

  }, error = function(e) {
    cat(sprintf("  ✗ FAILED %s: %s\n", nm, e$message)); flush.console()
  })
}

results_692 <- bind_rows(results_list)

cat(sprintf("\n══ Done. %d states simulated. Total: %.0f min ══\n",
            n_distinct(results_692$state),
            (proc.time()[["elapsed"]] - t_start) / 60))
cat(sprintf("Total simulated plans: %d\n", nrow(results_692)))
```
# 8 Results

```{r load-results, cache=FALSE}

ckpt_files <- list.files(CHECKPOINT_DIR, pattern = "\\.rds$", full.names = TRUE)

if (length(ckpt_files) == 0) {
  stop(paste0(
    "No checkpoint files found in '", CHECKPOINT_DIR, "/'.\n",
    "Run the simulation loop in Section 7.2 first, then re-knit."
  ))
}

results_692 <- map_dfr(ckpt_files, function(f) {
  s <- readRDS(f)
  s$metrics
}) %>%
  mutate(
    bias_dir = factor(case_when(
      mean_median_diff >  0.01 ~ "Pro-Republican",
      mean_median_diff < -0.01 ~ "Pro-Democratic",
      TRUE                     ~ "Neutral"
    ), levels = c("Pro-Republican","Neutral","Pro-Democratic"))
  )

cat(sprintf("Results loaded: %d states | %d total simulated plans\n",
            n_distinct(results_692$state), nrow(results_692)))
cat("States:", paste(sort(unique(results_692$state)), collapse=", "), "\n")


if (!exists("actual_state")) {
  no_total_states <- c("ALASKA","ARIZONA","ARKANSAS","HAWAII","IOWA",
                       "MARYLAND","NORTH CAROLINA","SOUTH CAROLINA",
                       "WEST VIRGINIA")
  raw_tmp <- read_csv(
    "HOUSE_precinct_general.csv",
    col_types = cols(county_fips = col_character(),
                     district    = col_character(),
                     votes       = col_double(),
                     .default    = col_character()),
    show_col_types = FALSE
  ) %>%
    mutate(special = as.logical(special),
           writein = as.logical(writein),
           votes   = as.numeric(votes)) %>%
    filter(!special | is.na(special),
           !writein | is.na(writein),
           office == "US HOUSE")

  actual_state <- raw_tmp %>%
    filter(party_simplified %in% c("DEMOCRAT","REPUBLICAN")) %>%
    mutate(keep = if_else(state %in% no_total_states, TRUE, mode == "TOTAL")) %>%
    filter(keep) %>%
    group_by(state, district, party_simplified) %>%
    summarise(votes = sum(votes, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = party_simplified, values_from = votes,
                values_fill = 0) %>%
    rename(dem_votes = DEMOCRAT, rep_votes = REPUBLICAN) %>%
    mutate(total_votes = dem_votes + rep_votes,
           dem_frac = if_else(total_votes > 0, dem_votes/total_votes, NA_real_)) %>%
    filter(!district %in% c("STATEWIDE","AT-LARGE",""),
           !is.na(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(district)))) %>%
    group_by(state) %>%
    summarise(
      n_districts = n(),
      dem_seats   = sum(dem_frac > 0.50, na.rm = TRUE),
      rep_seats   = sum(dem_frac < 0.50, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_dem    = mean(dem_frac, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_dem  = median(dem_frac, na.rm = TRUE),
      bias        = mean(dem_frac, na.rm=TRUE) - median(dem_frac, na.rm=TRUE),
      pct_comp    = mean(dem_frac >= 0.45 & dem_frac <= 0.55, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(bias_dir = case_when(
      bias >  0.01 ~ "Pro-Republican",
      bias < -0.01 ~ "Pro-Democratic",
      TRUE         ~ "Neutral"))

  rm(raw_tmp)
  cat("actual_state rebuilt from CSV.\n")
}

if (!exists("state_pops") || !"pop_per_rep_435" %in% names(state_pops)) {
  stop("Run Section 3 and 4 first (population and apportionment chunks), then re-run Section 8.")
}

actual_bias <- actual_state %>%
  filter(state %in% str_to_upper(results_692$state)) %>%
  summarise(mean_bias = mean(bias, na.rm = TRUE))

sim_avgs <- results_692 %>%
  group_by(state, ndists) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_bias      = mean(mean_median_diff, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_bias       = sd(mean_median_diff,   na.rm = TRUE),
    bias_lo       = quantile(mean_median_diff, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    bias_hi       = quantile(mean_median_diff, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_comp      = mean(pct_competitive,   na.rm = TRUE),
    comp_lo       = quantile(pct_competitive, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    comp_hi       = quantile(pct_competitive, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_dem_seats = mean(dem_seats,          na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_rep_seats = mean(rep_seats,          na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

comparison <- sim_avgs %>%
  mutate(state_upper = str_to_upper(state)) %>%
  left_join(actual_state, by = c("state_upper" = "state")) %>%
  mutate(
    bias_change = avg_bias - bias,
    comp_change = avg_comp - pct_comp,
    seat_change = avg_dem_seats - dem_seats
  )

never_simulated <- state_pops %>%
  filter(seats_692 == 1) %>%                       
  mutate(state_upper = str_to_upper(state_name),
         state = state_name, ndists = seats_692) %>%
  left_join(actual_state, by = c("state_upper" = "state")) %>%
  select(state, ndists, any_of(names(comparison)))  

comparison <- bind_rows(comparison, never_simulated)

MIN_DISTS_FOR_SIG <- 3L

sig_flags <- results_692 %>%
  group_by(state) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    st_upper <- str_to_upper(.y$state)
    act <- actual_state %>% filter(state == st_upper)
    n_dists <- unique(.x$ndists)

    if (nrow(act) == 0 || n_dists < MIN_DISTS_FOR_SIG) {
      return(tibble(bias_pctile = NA_real_, comp_pctile = NA_real_))
    }

    bias_var_ok <- sd(.x$mean_median_diff, na.rm = TRUE) > 0
    comp_var_ok <- sd(.x$pct_competitive,  na.rm = TRUE) > 0

    tibble(
      bias_pctile = if (bias_var_ok) mean(.x$mean_median_diff <= act$bias[1], na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
      comp_pctile = if (comp_var_ok) mean(.x$pct_competitive  <= act$pct_comp[1], na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_
    )
  }) %>%
  ungroup()

comparison <- comparison %>%
  left_join(sig_flags, by = "state") %>%
  mutate(
    bias_outlier = bias_pctile < 0.025 | bias_pctile > 0.975,
    comp_outlier = comp_pctile < 0.025 | comp_pctile > 0.975
  )

swing <- comparison %>%
  mutate(
    dem_share_actual = dem_seats / n_districts,
    dem_share_sim    = avg_dem_seats / ndists,
    share_change     = dem_share_sim - dem_share_actual
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(seat_change)))

actual_dir <- actual_state %>%
  filter(state %in% str_to_upper(results_692$state)) %>%
  count(bias_dir) %>%
  mutate(pct = n / sum(n), system = "Actual 2024 (435 seats)")

sim_dir <- results_692 %>%
  count(bias_dir) %>%
  mutate(pct = n / sum(n), system = "Simulated (692 seats)")

cat("All Section 8 data objects built successfully.\n")
```

```{r state-averages}

tbl5_data <- comparison %>%
  select(state, n_districts, ndists,
         bias, avg_bias, bias_lo, bias_hi, bias_change, bias_outlier,
         pct_comp, avg_comp, comp_lo, comp_hi, comp_outlier) %>%
  mutate(
    across(c(bias, avg_bias, bias_lo, bias_hi, bias_change), ~round(.x, 4)),
    bias_ci  = sprintf("[%.4f, %.4f]", bias_lo, bias_hi),
    across(c(pct_comp, avg_comp), ~percent(.x, accuracy = 0.1)),
    comp_ci  = sprintf("[%s, %s]",
                        percent(comp_lo, accuracy = 0.1),
                        percent(comp_hi, accuracy = 0.1)),
    bias_out = coalesce(bias_outlier, FALSE),
    comp_out = coalesce(comp_outlier, FALSE),
    sig_flag = case_when(
      is.na(bias_outlier) & is.na(comp_outlier) ~ "\u2014",
      bias_out & comp_out                       ~ "\u2020\u2021",
      bias_out                                  ~ "\u2020",
      comp_out                                  ~ "\u2021",
      TRUE                                        ~ ""
    )
  ) %>%
  select(state, n_districts, ndists,
         bias, avg_bias, bias_ci, bias_change,
         pct_comp, avg_comp, comp_ci, sig_flag)
```

```{r}
    scales::comma(round(mean(state_pops$pop_per_rep_435))),
    scales::comma(round(sd(state_pops$pop_per_rep_435))),
    format(round(max(state_pops$pop_per_rep_435)/min(state_pops$pop_per_rep_435), 2), nsmall = 2),
    format(round(mean(actual_state$bias, na.rm=TRUE), 4), nsmall = 4),
    format(round(mean(actual_state$bias_dir=="Pro-Republican", na.rm=TRUE), 3), nsmall = 3),
    format(round(mean(actual_state$bias_dir=="Pro-Democratic", na.rm=TRUE), 3), nsmall = 3),
    "—",
    format(round(mean(actual_state$pct_comp, na.rm=TRUE), 3), nsmall = 3),
    format(round(sd(actual_state$pct_comp, na.rm=TRUE), 3), nsmall = 3),
    "—"
  ),
  `Simulated 692-Seat (Cube Root Rule)` = c(
    scales::comma(round(mean(state_pops$pop_per_rep_692))),
    scales::comma(round(sd(state_pops$pop_per_rep_692))),
    format(round(max(state_pops$pop_per_rep_692)/min(state_pops$pop_per_rep_692), 2), nsmall = 2),
    format(round(mean(results_692$mean_median_diff, na.rm=TRUE), 4), nsmall = 4),
    format(round(mean(results_692$bias_dir=="Pro-Republican", na.rm=TRUE), 3), nsmall = 3),
    format(round(mean(results_692$bias_dir=="Pro-Democratic", na.rm=TRUE), 3), nsmall = 3),
    sprintf("%d / %d states", n_sig_bias, n_tested_bias),
    format(round(mean(results_692$pct_competitive, na.rm=TRUE), 3), nsmall = 3),
    format(round(sd(sim_avgs$avg_comp, na.rm=TRUE), 3), nsmall = 3),
    sprintf("%d / %d states", n_sig_comp, n_tested_comp)
  )
)

tbl8_kable <- tbl8 %>%
  kable(align = c("l","r","r"),
        caption = tbl_title("Benchmark Scorecard"),
        escape  = FALSE) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped","hover","bordered"),
                full_width = FALSE, position = "center") %>%
  pack_rows("Benchmark 1: Interstate Population Parity", 1, 3) %>%
  pack_rows("Benchmark 2: Partisan Bias",               4, 7) %>%
  pack_rows("Benchmark 3: Competitiveness",             8, 10) %>%
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE)

tbl8_kable

save_kable_png(tbl8_kable, "scorecard")
```
